mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5.0% indicates a tightening labor market, increasing corporate profits and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE falls below 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts and retail sales (both above 12-month moving averages) signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are above 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate exceeding 2.5% triggers expectations of Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production index above 100 indicates strong manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO is above 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 600.0 thousand units signals a robust housing market, increasing construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where HOUST exceeds 600.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS above 12-month moving average) combined with falling unemployment (UNRATE below 5.0%) indicates a tight labor market, increasing corporate profits and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where PAYEMS is above 12-month moving average and UNRATE is below 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth exceeding 0.5% monthly indicates robust consumer spending, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
